response.overview: To dispute a charge with Lindblad Expeditions Cruises, you should first contact their customer support or reservations+1-866-259-1002(US) team directly to request a billing review. Contact Lindblad Expeditions Directly462 (NZ) Mailing Address: LindbladCruises.com, 15147 N Scottsdale Rd Ste 210, Scottsdale, AZ 85254 Prepare Your Documentation Before speaking +1-866-259-1002(US) with a representative or filing a formal dispute, gather the following evidence: Your booking reference number or itinerary details. Copies of your credit card or bank statements showing the exact unauthorized or duplicate charge. Written correspondence, confirmation emails, or receipts from Lindblad Expeditions+1-866-259-1002(US)  Escalate to Your Card Issuer or Bank If Lindblad Expeditions does not resolve the issue or offer a fair refund: +1-866-259-1002(US) +1-866-259-1002(US)
